5b0d3a7e-4c1f-4e2a-9a55-1d6c0f2b7e11.background: Linea runs weekend trains from Dublin to Galway and wants more couples and families to take them.
5b0d3a7e-4c1f-4e2a-9a55-1d6c0f2b7e11.objectives: Lift weekend return bookings by 12% over the summer.
5b0d3a7e-4c1f-4e2a-9a55-1d6c0f2b7e11.audience: Couples and young families in Dublin who drive west two or three weekends a year and arrive tired.
5b0d3a7e-4c1f-4e2a-9a55-1d6c0f2b7e11.insight: A drive is a job somebody has to do. A train journey is time somebody gives back to you.
5b0d3a7e-4c1f-4e2a-9a55-1d6c0f2b7e11.smp: The weekend starts when you sit down.
5b0d3a7e-4c1f-4e2a-9a55-1d6c0f2b7e11.desired_response: Think the train is quicker than I assumed. Feel the trip is part of the break. Book a weekend return.
5b0d3a7e-4c1f-4e2a-9a55-1d6c0f2b7e11.mandatories: Weekend return fare. No anti-car tone (shared regional partners).

insights.text: Arriving tired is the worst part of the weekend.
A drive is a job somebody has to do; a train journey is time somebody gives back.
Rivals sell the destination; nobody sells the journey.
One person does every drive, and quietly resents it.
Most weekends are decided on a Friday.
People already call the train ride a highlight.
The holiday starts before you leave: lounges and queues sell the build-up.
What if the fare were the surprise, not the catch?
Meal kits sell the hour back.
Nobody wants to argue about the motorway.

crew.heading: Leap out of travel entirely: lounges, theme parks, cruises. Then come back.

territories.name: Already Started
territories.thought: The weekend doesn't start at the hotel. It starts at Platform 4.
territories.why: The brief says the weekend starts when you sit down; this route makes that the whole story.
risks: SkyHop's 'The holiday starts at the gate' is close. Rail has to own the stronger version: two hours, not fifty minutes.

territories.thought: The best part of the train is the trip home. Sunday evening, no traffic, no dread.
territories.why: Most campaigns sell the way out. Nobody sells the way home.
risks: The weekend-return fare has to be clear or it reads as a one-way message.
